verdict.auditor_notes: The report presents a coherent, internally consistent analysis. The descriptive statistics (means, SDs, n), test statistics (t = -1.13, df = 43.7, p = 0.2643), confidence interval (-6.67 to 1.88), Cohen's d (-0.33 with pooled SD = 7.34), and Mann-Whitney U results (U = 219.0, p = 0.1577) are all mutually consistent with each other. The methodology (Welch's t-test, two-sided, α=0.05) matches what was requested. The report discloses the sensitivity analysis, discusses site heterogeneity, and acknowledges no exclusions were applied. The conclusion (trial does not meet primary endpoint) follows logically from the p-value exceeding 0.05. There are no signs of cherry-picking, fabrication, or methodological drift visible in the final report.
